## Hash-Chain Audit Trail Status

SHA-256 tamper-evident hash chains are implemented on all critical Time & Payroll tables:

| Table | Records | With Hash | Coverage |
|-------|---------|-----------|----------|
| time_entries | 1 | 1 | 100% |
| timesheets | 192 | 192 | 100% |
| payroll_periods | 1 | 1 | 100% |

### Hash Chain Strategy

- **time_entries:** Per-user chain, ordered by user_id then clock_in
- **timesheets:** Per-user chain, ordered by user_id then date
- **payroll_periods:** Global chain, ordered by pay_period_start

### SOX-Significant Fields Covered

All SOX-significant fields are included in hash computation:
- Core data fields (hours, dates, amounts)
- Workflow state and status
- Approval metadata (approved_by, approved_at)
- Lock metadata (locked_by, locked_at)
- Processing status

## Separation of Duties (SoD) Controls

### Active SoD Requirements

1. User cannot approve own timesheet
2. Time entry is separate from payroll processing
3. Payroll export requires manager+ role
4. Payroll period locking requires dual authorization
5. Payroll period admin lock requires REQUEST → APPROVE by different users
6. GPS override approval requires secondary authorization
7. High-value timesheet corrections (>2 hours or locked period) require dual-auth
8. Bulk corrections require dual-auth approval with SoD enforcement

### Dual-Auth Configuration

| Flow | Enabled | Required Roles | Same-User Blocked |
|------|---------|----------------|-------------------|
| Payroll Period Admin Lock | YES | manager, admin, super_admin, owner | YES |
| GPS Override Approval | YES | supervisor+ | YES |
| Payroll Export | YES | manager+ | YES |
| Bulk Corrections | YES | manager+ | YES |
| High-Value Corrections | YES | supervisor+ | YES |
